```{r}
rm(list = ls())

theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Read in the data of the models 
```{r}
# Read in the waic (only models that converged)
waic_df <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waic.rds"))
# Define models converging that have a sine function 
df_converged <- filter(waic_df, dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08", "seallsero_s08"), 
                       mod_out == "imm")
```

# Extract mean cos and sin coefficients of the sine wave ===========================================
```{r}
all_coefcosine <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefcosine.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Read in the coeficients 
  sapply(str_subset(df_converged$mod, "cs"), function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$coef}/coef_{x}"))$fixed %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "parameter") %>%
      # Coefficients of the intercepts, cos and sin
      filter(str_detect(parameter, "Int|reg|cos|sin")) %>%
      filter(str_detect(parameter, "sd_", negate = TRUE))
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi)
    left_join(df_converged, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
    # From param to variables (param, imm_name, clu) -----------------------------------------------
    mutate(
      # Remove strings pi_vac_week_v1 and :
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "pi_vac_week_v1|:"),
      # Define parameter type (int, p_cos, p_sin)
      param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "p_cos",
                        str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "p_sin",
                        .default = "int"),
      # Remove strings parameter type 
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "Intercept|cos|sin"),
      # Define immunogenicity name between immvals1anti and _
      imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"), 
      # Remove strings immunogenicity name
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, paste0("immvals1anti", imm_name, "_")),
      # Remove strings reg 
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, reg), 
      # Define cluster name and reference value 
      clu = case_when(str_detect(reg, "reg_2") & parameter == "" ~ "1_North",
                      str_detect(reg, "reg_3|reg_4|reg_6") & parameter == "" ~ "1_Temperate",
                      !is.na(reg) & parameter != "" ~ parameter)) %>%
    select(pat, mod, param, mod_name, reg, clu, imm_name, Estimate, mod_out, dat, vac, gauss, 
           pat_tidy, multi) %>%
    # Obtain cos and sin per clu -------------------------------------------------------------------
    pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>% 
    group_by(mod, reg, imm_name) %>%
    mutate(
      inti = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(int)),  
      p_cosi = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(p_cos)),  
      p_sini = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(p_sin))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      int = int + inti,
      p_cos = p_cos + p_cosi,
      p_sin = p_sin + p_sini) %>%
    select(-c(inti, p_cosi, p_sini)) %>%
    # Estimate amplitude and phase -----------------------------------------------------------------
    mutate(amp_ls = fun_amp_ls(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int),
           phi = fun_phi(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, phi_type = "week"),
           amp = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "amp_ns"),
           mu_ns = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "mu_ns")) %>%
    # Fix names ----------------------------------------------
    rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_mean"), .cols = c(int, p_cos, p_sin, amp_ls, amp, phi, mu_ns))
  })
```

# Extract covars coefficients ======================================================================
```{r}
all_coefcovars <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefcovars.rds"), dir = "", {
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    # Read in the coeficients 
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$coef}/coef_{x}"))$fixed %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "parameter")
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    # Coefficients of the covars only 
    filter(str_detect(parameter, "cos|sin", negate =TRUE)) %>%
    rename_with(tolower) %>% 
    rename(est = estimate, est_se = est.error, est_ci95lo = 'l-95% ci', est_ci95up = 'u-95% ci') %>%
    select(mod, parameter, starts_with("est")) %>%
    # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi) --------
    left_join(df_converged, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
    # From param to variables (imm_name, param, param_i) -------------------------------------------
    mutate(
      imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "immvals1anti"),
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, paste0(imm_name, "_")),
      param = case_when(
        str_detect(parameter, "reg_") ~ reg,
        str_detect(parameter, "vac_name_v1") ~ "vac_name_v1",
        str_detect(parameter, "sex") ~ "sex",
        .default = parameter),
      param_i = case_when(
        str_detect(parameter, "sexM") ~ "M",
        str_detect(parameter, reg) ~ str_remove_all(parameter, reg),
        str_detect(parameter, "vac_name_v1") ~ str_remove_all(parameter, "vac_name_v1"))) %>%
    select(-parameter) %>%
    select(mod, param, param_i, everything())
})
```

# Extract random effects coefficients ==============================================================
```{r}
all_coefre <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefre.rds"), dir = "", {
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    # Read in the coefficients 
    coef <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$coef}/coef_{x}"))
    coef$random$shape <- coef$spec_pars
    # Return coefficients
    lapply(coef$random, rownames_to_column, var = "parameter") %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "re") 
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    rename_with(tolower) %>%
    # Rename estimate summary
    rename(est = estimate, est_se = est.error, est_ci95lo = 'l-95% ci', est_ci95up = 'u-95% ci') %>%
    select(mod, parameter, re, starts_with("est")) %>%
    # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi) ----------
    left_join(df_converged, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
    # From param to variables (imm_name1, imm_name2, clu) --------------------------------------------
    mutate(imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
           parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "immvals1anti|_"),
           parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, replace_na(imm_name, "NA")),
           param = if_else(str_detect(parameter, "Intercept"), "re", parameter),
           param_i = if_else(param == "sigma", "sigma", re)) %>%
    select(-c(parameter, re)) %>%
    select(mod, param, param_i, everything())
})
```

# Extract correlation matrix =======================================================================

```{r}
df_converged_multi <- filter(waic_df, dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08", "seallsero_s08"), 
                       mod_out == "imm", multi = TRUE)

all_coefrescor <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefrescor.rds"), dir = "", {
  sapply(str_subset(df_converged_multi$mod, "multi"), function(x) {
    # Read in the coefficients
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$coef}/coef_{x}"))$rescor_pars %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "parameter")
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    rename_with(tolower) %>%
    rename(rescor = estimate,
           rescor_se = est.error,
           rescor_ci95lo = 'l-95% ci',
           rescor_ci95up = 'u-95% ci') %>%
    select(mod, parameter, starts_with("rescor")) %>%
    # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi) ----------
    left_join(df_converged, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
    # From param to variables (imm_name1, imm_name2, clu) --------------------------------------------
    mutate(parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "rescor|anti|immvals1|\\(|\\)")) %>%
    separate(parameter, into = c("patuni1", "patuni2"), sep = ",") %>%
    mutate(across(c(patuni1, patuni2), ~ case_when(
      pat %in% c("multi_dtpa", "multi_pertua") & .x == "pertupt" ~ "pertuapt",
      pat == "multi_dtpw" & .x == "pertupt" ~ "pertuwpt",
      pat == "multi_ipv" & .x == "polio1" ~ "ipv1",
      pat == "multi_ipv" & .x == "polio2" ~ "ipv2",
      pat == "multi_ipv" & .x == "polio3" ~ "ipv3",
      pat == "multi_opv" & .x == "polio1" ~ "opv1",
      pat == "multi_opv" & .x == "polio2" ~ "opv2",
      pat == "multi_opv" & .x == "polio3" ~ "opv3",
      pat == "multi_pertua" & .x == "pertufha" ~ "pertuafha",
      pat == "multi_pertua" & .x == "pertuprn" ~ "pertuaprn", 
      .default = .x
    ))) %>%
    # From imm_name1 to patuni names and tidy ------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(rename(tidy_names_pat, patuni1 = pat, patuni_tidy1 = pat_tidy), by = join_by(patuni1)) %>%
    left_join(rename(tidy_names_pat, patuni2 = pat, patuni_tidy2 = pat_tidy), by = join_by(patuni2))
})
```

# Extract draws from the posterior for covars coefficients factors =================================
(to make the differences we want)
```{r}
all_samplescovarsfct <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplescovarsfct.rds"), dir = "", {
  sam_diff <- map_dfr(
    df_converged$mod, \(m)
      readRDS(glue("{dirs$samples}/samples_{m}")) %>%
        mutate(sam_no = row_number(), mod = m) %>%
        pivot_longer(-c(sam_no, mod), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "estimate") %>%
        # Coefficients of the intercepts, regions and vaccine names 
        filter(str_detect(parameter, "Intercept|reg|vac_name_v1|sex"),
               !str_detect(parameter, "sd_|cos|sin"))) %>%
  # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi) --------
    left_join(df_converged, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  # From param to variables (imm_name, param, param_i) -------------------------------------------
    mutate(
      imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "immvals1anti|b_") %>% 
                    str_remove_all(paste0(imm_name, "_")),
      param = case_when(
        str_detect(parameter, "Intercept") ~ "int",
        str_detect(parameter, "sex") ~ "sex",
        str_detect(parameter, "reg_") ~ reg,
        str_detect(parameter, "vac_name_v1") ~ "vac_name_v1",
        .default = parameter),
      param_i = case_when(
        str_detect(parameter, "sexM") ~ "M",
        str_detect(parameter, reg) ~ str_remove_all(parameter, reg),
        str_detect(parameter, "vac_name_v1") ~ str_remove_all(parameter, "vac_name_v1"))) %>%
    select(-parameter) %>%
    select(mod, param, param_i, everything())
  
  # For each factor, obtain the levels estimates, not differences from index
  sam_mean <- list("sex","reg", "vac_name_v1") %>%
  map_dfr(\(x)
   group_by(sam_diff, mod) %>%
     filter(str_detect(str_c(c(param), collapse = "|"), x)) %>%
     ungroup() %>%
     filter(str_detect(param, str_c(c("int", x), collapse = "|"))) %>%
     mutate(
       param_i = case_when(
         x == "sex" & param == "int" ~ "F",
         x == "reg" & param == "int" & reg %in% c("reg_3", "reg_4", "reg_6") ~ "1_Temperate",
         x == "reg" & param == "int" & reg == "reg_2" ~ "1_North",
         x == "vac_name_v1" & param == "int" & pat %in% c("dipht", "tetan") ~ "dtpa", 
         x == "vac_name_v1" & param == "int" & str_detect(pat, "strep") ~ "strep10",
         .default = param_i),
       param_level = x) %>%
     group_by(mod, param_level, imm_name, sam_no) %>%
     mutate(inti = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(estimate))) %>%
     ungroup() %>%
     mutate(estimate_level = estimate + inti) %>%
     select(-inti)
  )
  return(sam_mean)
})
```

# Extract draws from the posterior for amplitude and phase =========================================
```{r}
all_samplescosine <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplescosine.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Read in the coeficients 
  sapply(str_subset(df_converged$mod, "cs"), function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$samples}/samples_{x}")) %>%
      mutate(sam_no = row_number()) %>%
      pivot_longer(-sam_no, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "Estimate") %>%
      # Coefficients of the intercepts, cos and sin
      filter(str_detect(parameter, "Int|reg|cos|sin")) %>%
      filter(str_detect(parameter, "sd_", negate = TRUE))
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi)
    left_join(df_converged, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
    # From param to variables (param, imm_name, clu) -----------------------------------------------
    mutate(
      # Remove strings initial b_
      parameter = sub("^b_", "", parameter),
      # Remove strings pi_vac_week_v1 and :
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "pi_vac_week_v1|:"), 
      # Define parameter type (int, p_cos, p_sin)
      param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "p_cos",
                        str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "p_sin",
                        .default = "int"), 
      # Remove strings parameter type 
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "Intercept|cos|sin"),
      # Define immunogenicity name between immvals1anti and _
      imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"), 
      # Remove strings immunogenicity name
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, paste0("immvals1anti", imm_name, "_")), 
      # Remove strings reg 
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, reg), 
      # Define cluster name and reference value 
      clu = case_when(str_detect(reg, "reg_2") & parameter == "" ~ "1_North",
                      str_detect(reg, "reg_3|reg_4|reg_6") & parameter == "" ~ "1_Temperate",
                      !is.na(reg) & parameter != "" ~ parameter)) %>%
    select(sam_no, pat, mod, param, mod_name, reg, clu, imm_name, Estimate, mod_out, dat, vac, gauss, 
           pat_tidy, multi) %>%
    # Obtain cos and sin per clu -------------------------------------------------------------------
    pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>%
    group_by(mod, reg, imm_name, sam_no) %>%
    mutate(
      inti = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(int)),  
      p_cosi = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(p_cos)),  
      p_sini = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(p_sin))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      int = int + inti,
      p_cos = p_cos + p_cosi,
      p_sin = p_sin + p_sini) %>%
    select(-c(inti, p_cosi, p_sini)) %>%
    # Estimate amplitude and phase -----------------------------------------------------------------  
    mutate(sam_amp_ls = fun_amp_ls(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int),
           sam_phi = fun_phi(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, phi_type = "week"),
           sam_amp = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "amp_ns"),
           mu_ns = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "mu_ns")) %>%
    group_by(mod, clu, imm_name) %>% 
    mutate(across(c(
      int, p_cos, p_sin, sam_amp_ls, mu_ns, sam_amp),
      list(mean = mean, median = median, q25 = ~quantile(.x, 0.25), q75 = ~quantile(.x, 0.75),
           ci95lo = ~quantile(.x, 0.025), ci95up = ~quantile(.x, 0.975), min = min, max = max),
      .names = "sam_{.col}_{.fn}"),
      sam_phi_mean = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_mean"),
      sam_phi_median = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_median"),
      sam_phi_q25 = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_q25"),
      sam_phi_q75 = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_q75"),
      sam_phi_ci95lo = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_ci95lo"),
      sam_phi_ci95up = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_ci95up"),
      sam_phi_min = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_min"),
      sam_phi_max = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_max")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    rename_with(~str_replace_all(.x, "sam_sam_", "sam_")) %>%
    # Add mean estimates ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(distinct(all_coefcosine, mod, clu, imm_name, int_mean, p_cos_mean, p_sin_mean, 
                       amp_ls_mean, amp_mean, phi_mean, mu_ns_mean), 
              by = join_by(mod, clu, imm_name)) %>%
    # Add imm_name tidy names ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(tidy_names_imm, by = join_by(imm_name)) %>%
    # Add clu tidy names ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(tidy_names_clu, by = join_by(clu))
  })
```

```{r}
all_samplesshape <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplesshape.rds"), dir = "", {
  sam_diff <- map_dfr(
    df_converged$mod, \(m)
      readRDS(glue("{dirs$samples}/samples_{m}")) %>%
        mutate(sam_no = row_number(), mod = m) %>%
        pivot_longer(-c(sam_no, mod), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "estimate") %>%
        # Coefficients of the intercepts, regions and vaccine names 
        filter(str_detect(parameter, "shape"))) %>%
  # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi) --------
    left_join(df_converged, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  # From param to variables (imm_name, param, param_i) -------------------------------------------
    mutate(param = parameter) %>%
    select(-parameter) %>%
    select(mod, param, everything())
  return(sam_diff)
})

all_samplesshape
```
